title: Distinguish a host-local Resume refusal from an Engram policy refusal in the control-card title
outcome: The retained-authorization Resume refusal is presented as a host-local recovery outcome without implying a fresh Engram policy decision.
acceptance: The control card for retained_authorization_requires_reconciliation has accurate host-local wording while ordinary Engram policy refusals retain their existing presentation.
Relevant UI tests cover the distinction and the maintained gate is green on the landing input.
